list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18)
note: Official names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description. Counts (where shown) are the targets PSN tracks. Nothing here has been verified by playing the game yet: where a step is not pinned down by the official description, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap stages in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally the open-world cleanup — and this one unlocks at the end. It cannot be missed: it is awarded automatically once the other 54 are done.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Awarded automatically; save it for last by following the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. This is the first mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally in the opening hour: follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen appears. No preparation is needed and nothing here can be skipped past.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter trophy pops when the last mission of the chapter ends, so just keep playing the story in order and it will come. If a mission fails, retry it from the mission-failed screen — progress is kept.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story chapter — it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Play the story missions in order; side activities can wait until after the story if you prefer to keep the pace up.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story chapter — it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission. By this point the map is well opened up, but the chapter trophy itself only needs the story missions done — collectibles and activities are separate trophies.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story chapter — it pops when the chapter ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before moving on to the final mission, do the partner trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy) — they need your partner beside you, and the finale is the natural point of no return.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Do the partner trophies before the final mission that follows this chapter.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission to earn this gold trophy. Before you start it, clear the two partner trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy), since they need your partner with you and the finale may change who is available afterwards. The final mission itself is unmissable — it pops when the credits roll.
trophies.note: Unmissable, but do Hot Together and Retail Therapy first — the finale is the point of no return for partner play.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its end. Mission trophies pop at the mission-complete screen, so follow the objectives as they appear and finish the mission. If it fails partway, retry — the trophy is awarded on a successful completion, whenever that happens.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to its end. Heist missions in GTA games usually have a setup and a payoff: finish both parts and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Stock up on armour and ammo before the payoff if the game lets you — the official description gives no loadout, so go in prepared and adapt to what the mission asks.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play to its end. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. As with the other named-mission trophies, the only requirement the official description gives is completing the mission, so follow its objectives and finish it.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners to its end. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. The name suggests a show or headline event, but the official description names only the mission, so the safe play is simply to finish Headliners and let the trophy pop.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to its end. VCIA is Vice City International Airport, so expect the mission to play out there, but the official description only asks for the mission's completion — follow the objectives until the mission-complete screen and the trophy pops.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. The name suggests a large set-piece operation, so go in with full health, armour and ammo if the game allows it. The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen once the operation is finished.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Story mission — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion stat — the gold trophy for doing everything. This is a last-stage trophy: finish the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the open-world trophies first, then check the in-game stats screen for whatever percentage is left. In GTA games the stat counts story missions, stranger missions, activities and collectibles, so the checklist in this guide is effectively the work list; the final few percent usually hide in one activity type you have barely touched.
trophies.note: Unmissable, but last. Check the in-game stats screen for the remaining percentage.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, airtime, near-misses, drifts and the like, counted cumulatively across free roam. The count ticks up whenever the game flashes a stunt, so the fastest way is to keep a fast car or bike and chain jumps and near-misses on the highways around Vice City. Use the tracker's counter below to log your running total, since the game only shows the trophy when it pops at 250.
trophies.note: Cumulative — it counts across the whole game, so it builds up naturally while you play.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 250: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's nine activity types once. The activities the trophy list names give you the menu to work from: races, fishing, the shooting range, Top Fun drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, challenges and stunts. Open the activities menu and sample one of each — you only need to try them, not win or master them, so one attempt at each is enough.
trophies.note: One try each is enough — no wins required.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Nine activity types: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a shooting range and work through its challenge list — each challenge has its own weapon and scoring target, and the range shows your medal per challenge, so you can see which ones still need gold. Use the weapon the challenge specifies, take the time bonus into account (steady, aimed shots beat spraying), and replay any challenge you only silver until it turns gold. Log each gold in the counter below.
trophies.note: Every one of the 42 must be gold — a silver anywhere holds the trophy back.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 42: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 race locations. Each location is its own course, so a win at one place does not count for another — you need a win everywhere. Learn each course's gates before racing it flat-out, cut corners where the gates allow, and use boost on the straights. The counter below tracks how many locations you have won at.
trophies.note: One win per location, all 14 — a repeat win at the same spot does not count twice.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 14: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins of the same race. Work through the race list across vehicle classes and locations; the easier early races are the place to start, and the prize money helps fund the rest of the trophy hunt. Track your distinct wins in the counter below.
trophies.note: Distinct races only — winning the same race twice counts once.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 20: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find a fishing spot, take the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him: cast where the fish are, watch the line tension so it never snaps, and reel steadily rather than yanking. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win, whenever it comes.
trophies.note: Retryable — challenge Cal again as often as needed.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, pick a game and play it through to its end — the trophy asks for a completion, not a high score, so choose the shortest or easiest cabinet you find. One finished game is all it takes.
trophies.note: Any arcade game counts — pick the easiest cabinet.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger and side-character strands are chains of missions: keep taking Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map until the strand's last one completes and the trophy pops. Side strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but do them before the finale if you want the company.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Side strand — finish Andy's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep answering Kenton's calls and map markers until the strand ends — the trophy pops when the final mission completes. The name hints at boats, so expect water in the strand, but the official description only asks for the final mission, so just play the strand through.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Side strand — finish Kenton's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Follow Billy's markers until the strand's last mission is done and the trophy pops. The name suggests bikes and solo riding, but the requirement is just the strand's completion — play it through in order.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Side strand — finish Billy's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger markers appear around the map as you explore — each one starts a chain of missions, and a strand only counts when its chain is finished. Work through the strands as you find them (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have their own trophy, so their strands are five of the eight) and use the counter below to track completed strands.
trophies.note: A strand counts only when its whole chain is finished — starting one is not enough.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 8: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep taking Randy's missions as they appear until the strand's last one is done and the trophy pops. Supply-and-demand work suggests deliveries and pickups, but the official description only asks for the final mission, so play the strand through in order.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Side strand — finish Randy's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Follow Tyrone's markers until the strand ends — the trophy pops when the final mission completes. As with the other character strands, there is no separate task beyond finishing the chain.
trophies.note: Unmissable. Side strand — finish Tyrone's last mission.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic places — hilltops, beaches, quiet corners of the map — and each one counts when you meditate there. Explore the map's edges and high points to find them; the counter below tracks how many you have done. A spot only counts once, so a second visit to the same place adds nothing.
trophies.note: 18 distinct spots — each counts once.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 18: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret wants. Talk to Bret to learn which animal it is, then track it in the wild — move quietly, watch for its tracks or calls, and take the shot with a weapon that keeps the kill clean (a scoped rifle from range is the classic approach for a unique hunt). The trophy pops when the hunt is delivered, not when the animal is merely found.
trophies.note: The animal is unique — if the hunt goes wrong, track it again rather than assuming it is gone.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, houses, vehicles and out-of-the-way spots — and each set is complete only when you hold every card in it. Pick up every card you pass while doing other trophies, then sweep the map for the stragglers; the counter below tracks finished sets, not single cards.
trophies.note: Sets, not cards — one missing card holds a whole set back.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 3 sets: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game way of marking or tagging a spot, and each distinct location counts once — so the trick is breadth, not repetition. Use it at every new place you visit while exploring Leonida for the other trophies, and the count will climb without a dedicated grind; the counter below tracks your running total.
trophies.note: 100 distinct locations — repeating a spot adds nothing.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 100: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The challenges menu lists them across categories — driving, shooting, exploration and more — and each completed challenge ticks the count. Pick the short ones first (single-action challenges you can finish in a minute), then work down the list; the counter below tracks your total. Challenges overlap heavily with the other trophies, so many will complete themselves while you hunt.
trophies.note: Cumulative across categories — short challenges first, then the long ones.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 50: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner is the key: this only counts while your partner is with you, so do it before the final mission, while partner play is still available. Get the heat up (a robbery or a shootout in a busy area), then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — the trophy pops when the wanted level is gone and you are both free.
trophies.note: MISSABLE — do this before the final mission, while your partner is still around. After the finale, partner play may not be available.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three shops close together, hit them one after another, and keep the heat alive the whole time — do not lose the cops, do not get caught, and do not let the wanted level drop to zero between robberies. If the stars clear after shop two, the chain breaks and you start again. Like Hot Together, this needs your partner, so do it before the final mission.
trophies.note: MISSABLE — do this before the final mission, while your partner is still around. The wanted level must stay up through all three robberies.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in it (or otherwise log it) for the first time — so drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything unusual parked around Leonida. Variety is the whole game here; the counter below tracks your running total of distinct finds.
trophies.note: Distinct vehicles only — the same model twice counts once.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 100: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Pick a crowded fight — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — trigger Combat Focus when several enemies are in view, and take them down before the effect ends. A fast, accurate weapon and cover to reload behind make the difference; if you only get four, the count resets, so set the fight up again and go for all five in one go.
trophies.note: All five in a single use — a partial run does not carry over.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport by a departure nobody scheduled. In plain terms: get to a plane at VCIA and take off without going through the normal channels — steal one and get it airborne. Expect airport security and a wanted level, so have a fast route to the runway planned and get the wheels up before the response closes in.
trophies.note: Timing matters — do it in one clean run, and be ready for the airport's response.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks — the trophy's own description is a joke about how hot it gets inside them. The practical read: take on a Rhino, whether by destroying one or by surviving its attention, using heavy weapons (explosives, rocket launchers) since small arms will not do it. High wanted levels bring military hardware out, so build the heat up and be ready when a Rhino rolls in.
trophies.note: The official description is a joke, not a set of steps — heavy weapons are the honest advice.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move when guards and cameras are looking away, avoid witnesses, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Plan your entry and exit before you start, and if you are spotted, leave and try again — the trophy needs one clean run, and a failed attempt costs nothing but time.
trophies.note: One clean run is all it needs — a spotted attempt can be retried.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Each vault is its own job: get in, crack or force the vault, grab the cash, and get away clean before the response closes in. Plan the getaway first — a fast car stashed nearby beats any plan made mid-chase. The counter below tracks completed vaults; a vault where you get caught does not count.
trophies.note: Five vaults, each with a clean escape — a caught run does not count.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 5: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — spot one, stop it (ram it, block the road, or force the driver out), take the cash, and lose the response that follows. A quiet stretch of road and a fast getaway car make it far easier than trying it in the middle of Vice City.
trophies.note: One truck, one clean escape — pick a quiet road for the hit.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Discover all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area, so the work is simply going everywhere: drive the coast roads, the swamps, the small towns and the islands, and check the map for blank patches. The counter below tracks areas found; the last few are usually small places you drove past without noticing, so compare your map against the area list when you are down to a handful.
trophies.note: 52 named areas — the map shows what is still blank.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 52: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it, and get out. Work through the gangs one at a time and use the counter below to mark each gang done, so you can see which gangs are still untouched.
trophies.note: One operation per gang, all 9 gangs.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 9: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy it looking out at the water — the trophy is a quiet moment, not a challenge, so take it when you are passing through the area. Any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach should do; if it does not pop, try another spot with a clear view of the sea.
trophies.note: A quiet moment, not a challenge — do it while passing through Ocean Beach.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style. Get a car inside a vehicle showroom, then drive it straight out through the glass front. Pick a showroom with a big window, build a little speed inside, and aim for the glass — the trophy pops on the exit, not the entry, so the smash out is the part that counts.
trophies.note: The exit is what counts — drive out through the glass.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Head to the alley, start a game and follow through — play the game out rather than walking away mid-frame. The trophy's wording suggests completing the follow-through of a bowl, so finish the game you start and the trophy pops.
trophies.note: Finish the game you start — do not walk out mid-frame.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Do something with your partner that has mass appeal — a partnership moment the game recognises. The official description is deliberately vague, so the honest advice is to play the partner content together: hang out, do activities as a pair, and let the moment come. This is the kind of trophy that pops during natural partner play, so keep your partner involved while you work through the rest of the list.
trophies.note: The official description gives no concrete step — play the partner content together and it should come.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices — PSN tracks a count up to 500, and the trophy pops when it is full. Choices are the small decisions the game keeps offering (dialogue picks, approach choices, yes-or-no moments), so this is a long cumulative grind that fills up across a full playthrough. Keep choosing rather than skipping past prompts, and log your progress in the counter below.
trophies.note: Cumulative to 500 — it fills across a whole playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 500: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try — fail something, then nail it on the attempt straight after. The name says it plainly: the trophy is for a retry that works. Any activity you can fail and immediately retry qualifies, so if it has not popped by the end of your playthrough, pick a short challenge, fail it once on purpose, then pass it on the next attempt.
trophies.note: Retryable by design — a failed attempt followed by a pass is the trigger.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida — an unexplained event, the kind of oddity GTA games hide in the corners of the map. There is no fixed location in the official description, so explore the odd places: the swamps at night, the far edges of the map, the places that feel wrong. It is a random-encounter style trophy, so keep exploring and it will find you.
trophies.note: No fixed location is given — explore the strange corners of Leonida and keep an eye out.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon out of the vehicle as you pass, and connect. Low speed and a straight approach make it far easier than trying it at full tilt; if you miss, circle around and try again.
trophies.note: Slow and straight beats fast and wild — line the pass up first.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies, and your contacts clean them for a cut — keep feeding bills through until the cleaned total reaches $250,000. It is a money grind more than a skill test, so fold it into the rest of the hunt: rob, launder, repeat, and track the cleaned total in the counter below.
trophies.note: A money grind — keep laundering after every big score.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target $250,000: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles and everything else that takes cash. This fills naturally while you gear up for the other trophies, and big purchases (a good car, a full weapon loadout) move the needle fastest. Track your running spend in the counter below; it counts cumulative spend, not what you hold at any moment.
trophies.note: Cumulative spend — big purchases move it fastest.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target $100,000: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale around Leonida as you progress — check the property listings on the map and in the in-game property sites, and buy each one when you can afford it. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for the Whip It Good trophy, so buy them as you go rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.note: 8 garages — buy them as you go; they also store your discovered vehicles.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 8: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered. It pairs naturally with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good — register each new find as you go, and the two trophies climb together.
trophies.note: Pairs with Whip It Good — register each vehicle you discover.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and grade: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list. Target 10: PSNProfiles. Guide: our own advice, built from the official description.
